text:
I've been there several times, but the previous times I saw a male doctor. The last two times I saw a female doctor who spoke politely, but had a condescending look in her eyes. She spoke politely but so quickly that I was confused when I tried to speak to her; she spoke almost without breathing!
She examined patients but showed disdain through her words and gaze. She made my father wait with his mouth open for an examination; his throat was red, but he hadn't even fully opened his mouth, and she hadn't even shone the flashlight to his mouth before she said, "It's done." I was confused. Is this how a doctor examines patients? She didn't even see if he had teeth! 🤣 This is unacceptable.
She examined him and then proceeded to examine me without listening to me at all. She just kept asking questions until I was confused and couldn't breathe! 🤣 You can't just prescribe medication and leave without caring about the money; you need to have genuine care for your patients.

I don't need to be taught anything just an apology, right? It's my fault, but the system is wrong and the person who entered the wrong name was entered incorrectly. Didn't I apologize? Not at all. I'm in another province and just saw this. I'm so discouraged. The solution is to send it by post instead. And wait 3-5 days. I don't live in that province anyway. In short, it's a personal problem. The point is, there's not even an apology for entering the wrong information. Do I really have to apologize and say I'm sorry? Do I have to say something like this?
